reference.title: Add X and TikTok paid social Conversions API integration
reference.summary: Adds first-party paid-social Conversions API integration for X and TikTok in the `common/` package, with request building in `buildPaidSocialRequest` and delivery in `sendPaidSocialConversion` (`common/src/paid-social-capi.ts`) plus parsing and validation helpers in `common/src/util/paid-social-conversions.ts`. The X variant signs requests with OAuth 1.0a HMAC-SHA1 while excluding the JSON request body from the OAuth parameter base; TikTok posts to its business-api event endpoint with an Access-Token header and embeds a runtime-validated static auth callback path as the page URL, with no query or fragment. Delivery uses bounded retries with one immutable occurrence ID and a fresh OAuth nonce and timestamp on every attempt. It also adds optional `NEXT_PUBLIC_X_PIXEL_ID` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_PIXEL_ID` env vars in `common/src/env-schema.ts`, absent which first-party capture stays off.

reference.title: Add DeepSeek V4.1, GLM 5.3 and eval roots to provisioned tiers
reference.summary: Three new provisioned model rows - DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Pro, and GLM 5.3 - are added to common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and appended to FREEBUFF_PROVISIONED_MODELS, with matching 'base2-free-*' root agent ids registered in common/src/constants/free-agents.ts so provisioned-tier accounts are admitted onto their own root rather than the picker. The same commit registers staff-only evaluation roots 'base2-free-fable-test' and 'base2-free-astra-discount-test' tied to the hidden test model ids FREEBUFF_FABLE_5_1_TEST_MODEL_ID and FREEBUFF_GPT_6_ASTRA_DISCOUNT_TEST_MODEL_ID. Per the existing policy, none of these ids is spread into FREEBUFF_MODELS, every quota list, or any public picker.

reference.title: Sponsored verification against frozen acceptance criteria contract
reference.summary: Added a versioned, dependency-free acceptance-criteria contract (`ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1`) with `parseAcceptanceCriteriaContract`, `canonicalizeAcceptanceCriteriaContract`, `acceptanceCriteriaSha256`, and `mapAdvertiserSuccessCheck` mapping plain-language advertiser checks onto evidence methods (committed_diff, live_probe, partner_evidence, configuration, etc.). Added an independent verifier (`sponsored-verifier.ts`) with hard caps (`SPONSORED_VERIFIER_LIMITS`, zero-cost, 45s/8-call budget) and deterministic evaluation (`evaluateAcceptanceCriteria`) that hashes the frozen rubric, marks revision drift stale, and surfaces a `SponsoredVerificationPanel` plus a `verify-again` action on committed/landed/merged proposal rows. Legacy runs without a contract are explicitly not verifiable, and the conformance matrix now enforces VM-37/VM-38 so no surface can invent its own rubric.

reference.title: Freebuff agent cost mode escalation gate
reference.summary: A new `isFreebuffCostModeEscalation` predicate in `common/src/constants/freebuff-cost-mode.ts` detects when a Freebuff-owned agent id (publisher-locked to `codebuff`) is sent with a `cost_mode` other than `free`, which the docs note disables roughly twenty `isFreeModeRequest`-gated rules at once. The rule is only half the verdict: the call site composes it with the third-party-client detector from #3495/#3528 so that one of our agents on a non-free mode from a non-Freebuff client is the matched abuse shape, while the supported `codebuff/base2-free-luna` paid path stays 200. Accounts are individually exemptable via `FREEBUFF_ENFORCEION_EXEMPT_USER_IDS` (parsed by `parseExemptUserIds`), with exempt accounts still measured and logged but withheld from the downgrade, sticky `third_party_client` flag, and ban-sweep evidence.

reference.title: Fable 5.1 trial replaces Fable 5 across base2 and the CLI tmux shell
reference.summary: The Fable 5.1 (`anthropic/claude-fable-5.1`) trace campaign supersedes Fable 5 across the Freebuff CLI and base2 orchestrator, replacing `FREEBUFF_FABLE_5_MODEL_ID` with `FREEBUFF_FABLE_5_1_MODEL_ID` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` and rewiring every base2 root, reviewer, and the free-mode allowlist to the new id. A new `agents/tmux-cli-fable.ts` pins the tmux shell subagent to the campaign model, and `createBase2` in `agents/base2/base2.ts` dispatches to `tmux-cli-fable` exactly when the root runs Fable 5.1 so the session gate's cross-model rejection cannot drop a subagent onto another endpoint. The capacity-limited trial retains the hard ceiling of `FREEBUFF_LIMITED_OFFER_MAX_SESSIONS` (500) sessions and one-per-user admission set in this commit's constant cleanup, and the removed `agents/base3-free-fable.ts` had no CLI twin since Fable was a CLI-only limited offer.

reference.title: Release launcher verifies archive checksums before install
reference.summary: The npm release launcher now verifies each downloaded archive's sha256 against a `binaryChecksums` map published in the package's own `package.json` (or, for a self-update to `latest`, the npm registry version document), with a new standalone `write-binary-checksums.js` script stamping one hash per target into the manifest and a `verify` mode that fails the release if any target is uncovered. Verification fails closed: a missing or malformed checksum aborts the install, and `http.js`'s new `evaluateRedirect` additionally refuses redirect targets outside codebuff.com, freebuff.com, github.com, and `*.githubusercontent.com` while blocking https-to-http downgrades. The trust root for the archive therefore stays the npm registry rather than the download origin, leaving every redirect hop unable to substitute a binary. The launcher also gates repository-scoped `.agents` directories behind an interactive trust prompt (or the `CODEBUFF_TRUST_AGENT_DIRS` opt-in for CI), with `loadLocalAgents` and `loadMCPConfig` gaining `agentDirs`/`configDirs` options so trusted directories only are imported.

reference.title: SDK gates remote executable agents on publisher trust
reference.summary: The SDK now refuses a registry-fetched agent template whose `handleSteps` is a source string unless its publisher is trusted, instead handing that string to the runtime's `eval` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-programmatic-step.ts`. Trust is the union of `codebuff`, the `CODEBUFF_TRUSTED_AGENT_PUBLISHERS` env var, and the new `trustedAgentPublishers` option on `CodebuffClient` / `run()`, with an `UntrustedAgentPublisherError` surfaced to the run output naming the exact knob to set. Local `.agents` files and `agentDefinitions` are never gated, and data-only remote templates load unchanged. The gate travels alongside the existing `CODEBUFF_APP_URL` scheme/host validation as a trust floor under remote template execution.

reference.title: Meta Conversions API wiring for landing tracking
reference.summary: Added the Freebuff Meta Conversions API (CAPI) subsystem to the common package: NEXT_PUBLIC_META_PIXEL_ID is now a validated optional env var (digits only, max 32 chars) in common/src/env-schema.ts, and common/src/meta-capi.ts implements buildMetaConversionBody, sendMetaConversion, and a META_GRAPH_API_VERSION of v26.0, verified against Meta's official facebook-nodejs-business-sdk. The shared contract in common/src/util/meta-conversions.ts defines eligible event names (CompleteRegistration, CodingActivation, Subscribe), a 7-day activation window, DNT/GPC opt-out checks via metaTrackingOptedOut, and browser ID validation, while a desktop or CLI activation reports action_source 'other' rather than 'website' to keep signup attribution honest to Meta's expectations. The canSend hook is rechecked before every network attempt including retries, and the pixel ID being unset disables Freebuff landing tracking entirely.

reference.title: Runtime app URL override now validates scheme and host
reference.summary: The SDK's runtime `CODEBUFF_APP_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL` override is now gated by a shared rule in `common/src/util/runtime-app-url.ts`: only `https:` (any host) or `http:` on loopback/`*.localhost` is honored, with rejected values ignored and warned once. `getRuntimeAppUrlFromEnv` in `sdk/src/env.ts` applies that validation per variable before returning a value, falling back to the bundled URL so a process that can set an env var cannot redirect the credential-bearing API plane over plain http to a remote host. `isAllowedRuntimeAppUrl` is also re-exported from `sdk/src/index.ts` so Desktop and other bundling hosts apply the same single rule read at module load.

reference.title: CLI credentials and config dir locked to owner-only POSIX modes
reference.summary: The CLI now clamps `credentials.json` to `0o600` and the config directory to `0o700` at creation and after each write, with `tightenCredentialsFileMode` re-healing pre-existing loose files on read so existing installs are corrected without losing login state. Modes are best-effort and skipped on Windows, where POSIX bits do not apply, and a failed chmod cannot cost the user their session; this matches the owner-only posture already used by `sdk/src/byok.ts` and `sponsored-run.ts`. The change is scoped to the auth utilities in `cli/src/utils/auth.ts`, which own the bearer token for every API call.

reference.title: Generic advertiser setup invitation schema
reference.summary: A new non-billable discovery invitation type for reviewed generic advertiser offers was added to the ads subsystem in `common/src/ads/generic-setup-invitation.ts`. The `genericSetupInvitationSchema` Zod object defines a strict, schemaVersion-1 payload with fields for invitationId, campaignId, advertiserName, headline, body, optional cta, framework/surface enums, setupReason enum, expiresAt, and policyVersion/decisionId, plus a `GenericSetupInvitation` inferred type and the `GENERIC_SETUP_INVITATION_RECHECK_LABEL` constant, intended to drive a compatibility-check flow without implying billing readiness.

reference.title: CLI shows off-peak Freebucks pricing rows
reference.summary: The CLI model selector now renders an off-peak detail chip on rows whose Freebucks price follows a server-owned recurring schedule, via a new `freebucksOffPeakCopy` helper in `common/src/util/freebuff-off-peak-price.ts` (also shipped in the public CLI). The `FreebuffOffPeakPrice` type (startHourUtc, endHourUtc, price, regularPrice) wires the policy into `applyFreebucksPriceChanges`, `nextFreebucksPriceChange`, and `watchFreebucksPriceChanges` in `freebuff-price-changes.ts`, so the picker re-arms its quote projection and re-evaluates the daily UTC [start, end) window - including windows that cross midnight - even after a delayed wake or device sleep. Presentation only: prices and schedules come from the server and the resolved quote owns its badge without a second pricing clock, and terminals get an inline explanation since there is no hover.

reference.title: Foreign client detection enforces tool parameter schemas
reference.summary: Signal 1 in `detectForeignFreebuffClient` now requires a GENUINE signature tool - our name over our parameter schema via `isGenuineSignatureTool` - rather than the name-only rule, so a proxied request that just appends a hollow `end_turn` with an empty schema no longer passes. The `ForeignClientVerdict` type gains `hollowToolNames`, a log-bounded list of offered tools wearing our names without our schemas, making the next adaptation visible as a change in what those definitions look like. A memoized `canonicalToolParameterKeys` derives the shipped top-level keys from the Zod schemas in `toolParams`, so the comparison cannot drift from what our clients send.

reference.title: CLI model picker shows crossed-out list prices beside first-tab discounts
reference.summary: The CLI model picker now renders a row's regular list price struck through ahead of the discounted Freebucks price on rows moved by the first-tab offer, via a new `struck` field on row detail chips and a `detailText` helper that preserves the strike width in the centering math. The list price is the server-announced pre-discount value carried on the new `listPrices` field of `FreebuffFreebucksInfo`, resolved per model by `firstTabListPriceFor` and threaded through `applyFreebucksPriceChanges` so a scheduled price change moves the crossed-out original in lockstep. The offer copy was relabeled to "Limited-time first-tab discount" with explicit wording that the crossed-out price is the regular one, and a model is only crossed out when a real discount lowered it below its list price.

reference.title: Sponsored Git setup and invitation telemetry contracts added
reference.summary: Added two new data-contracts files for the sponsored Desktop Git setup handshake and its Supabase-backed invitation event telemetry. `common/src/ads/sponsored-git-setup.ts` defines the local, privacy-bounded data model (inspection status, file exclusions, preview, identity, and approval shapes) where the Desktop process owns Git and the filesystem while clients only render relative paths and return review selections. `common/src/ads/supabase-invitation-events.ts` adds a zod-validated event vocabulary (returned/displayed/clicked through setup_completed/setup_failed/proposal_linked) plus a reason enum (git_root, enclosing_repository, git_unavailable, etc.) carried in a strict request object whose clientVersion is supplied by the authenticated transport. The existing `common/src/ads/sponsored-capability.ts` enum gained `enclosing_repository` and `git_unavailable` reasons, and both `supabase-setup-invitation` V1 and V2 schemas gained an optional `attributionToken` field bounded to 1024 characters, optional in V2 so older strict readers stay compatible.

reference.title: Sponsored proposal card gains post-code setup guidance
reference.summary: SponsoredProposalViewModel gains a nullable setupGuide field plus setupExpectation, and the CLI SponsoredProposalBlock now renders inline setup prompts for the offered state and a dedicated Setup → verify section when setupGuide is present. The advertiser CTA label changed from “Create your ${advertiser_name} project” to “Set up ${advertiser_name}” and is now grouped under the setup prompt, keeping the CTA out of destination territory per the VM-33..VM-36 conformance checks added in sponsored-proposal-conformance.ts. Scope covers CLI (sponsored-proposal-block.tsx), shared core (sponsored-proposal-view.ts, sponsored-proposal-conformance.ts); the guide is only populated in ctaStates and stays null otherwise. setupGuide steps describe review, account setup, and verify-in-app without claiming live integration verification, since a finished run only proves local work.

reference.title: BMP and TIFF images transcoded to PNG or refused for vision providers
reference.summary: BMP and TIFF images are no longer sent to vision providers as-is: the CLI transcodes them to PNG via Jimp in `cli/src/utils/image-handler.ts`, while the SDK read-files tool refuses them in `sdk/src/tools/read-files.ts` with a conversion hint. Both formats are recognized as images but no provider decodes them, and sending one causes a 400 unsupported-image error for that turn and every later turn because history is replayed. The new `PROVIDER_IMAGE_MEDIA_TYPES` set and `isProviderSupportedImageMediaType` helper in `common/src/constants/images.ts` restrict inline provider media types to PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP; if Jimp cannot read the BMP/TIFF, the CLI returns 'Unsupported image format... Convert it to PNG or JPEG and try again', and the SDK error suggests converting with `magick` to a temp PNG.

reference.title: Recent limited country block reason adds account notice
reference.summary: The `FreebuffCountryBlockReason` union in common gains a `recent_limited_country` variant, and the restricted-capacity notice plus the model availability notice now explain that state. It is set by the access floor in `access-cache.ts` when the request's own network passes but the account was seen from a not-allowed country within the access-floor window, never by an IP lookup, so the account keeps that country's limits. Touches `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`, `common/src/util/freebuff-model-availability.ts`, and `common/src/constants/freebuff-spend-ceilings.ts`; the other reasons (anonymized or unknown country, missing client IP) fall through unchanged. Updated copy tells users who have moved to verify their country at freebuff.com/account?tab=country.

reference.title: CLI streak bonus lines display Freebucks daily rewards
reference.summary: The CLI landing screen now displays daily Freebucks streak rewards (`+<N> Freebucks every day`) via a new optional `freebucksDailyBonus` field in `FreebuffStreakResponse`. This makes the streak line server-decided for accounts on the Freebucks meter so advertised perks match what the ledger credits rather than promising session units or GLM bonuses the gate will not honor. Spanning `cli/src/components/freebuff-landing-screen.tsx`, `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts`, and `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts`, unmetered accounts and older servers returning null or undefined fall back to standard bonus session copy.

reference.title: {{advertiserClickId}} adds command-scoped CLI attribution
reference.summary: common/src/ads/sponsored-procedure-inputs.ts adds `ADVERTISER_CLICK_ID_PLACEHOLDER` (`{{advertiserClickId}}`) and `advertiserClickIdFromLink()`, extending `sponsoredProcedureRuntimeInputsSection()` to emit an `advertiserClickId` section when the procedure opts in alongside `{{advertiserLink}}`. It reuses the same advertiser link's opaque `bfcid` for command-scoped CLI attribution with shape validation only, since the server supplies the link and the postback verifies its HMAC. Scope is Shared/Core in that single file via its `isSignedConversionToken` import from `./sponsored-proposal-cta`. Extraction requires `https:` with exactly one `bfcid` value passing `isSignedConversionToken` and a 512-char limit matching the postback's `BFCID_MAX_CHARS` contract without an internal-package dependency, with missing attribution rendering unavailable so the model skips the dependent command instead of falling back to an unattributed conversion.

reference.title: Sponsored proposal refresh gate plus Supabase setup invitation schemas
reference.summary: `sponsoredProposalRefreshMayPoll` added in `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-refresh.ts`, `supabaseSetupInvitationSchema` `supabaseSetupInvitationCapabilitySchema` added in `common/src/ads/supabase-setup-invitation.ts`. Proposal check skips typing recency, requires `windowVisible` `threadIsActive`; setup invitation models read-only Desktop facts for `desktop_macos` `desktop_linux`. `schemaVersion: 1`, `setupReason: no_git_repository/no_committed_head`, provider evidence `missing/present/unknown`; transport holds no URL command, `SUPABASE_SETUP_INVITATION_RECHECK_LABEL` equals `Recheck setup`.

reference.title: gpt-5.6-luna BYOK fix, OpenRouter attribution via transform
reference.summary: BYOK `gpt-5.6-luna`, OpenRouter `openai/` bodies rewritten pre-serialization via `transformRequestBody` in `OpenAICompatibleChatLanguageModel` using `byokRequestTransform`; direct Luna swaps `max_tokens` to `max_completion_tokens`, strips `stop`, forces `reasoning_effort: none` with tools; OpenRouter injects `user`, `safety_identifier` from SHA-256 provider credential fingerprint. Live probes showed OpenAI rejecting both fields independently; Luna Chat Completions rejects function tools at default reasoning effort, Responses API required with reasoning plus tools; anonymous OpenRouter OpenAI traffic inherits shared policy block. Ships in `sdk/src/impl/byok-request.ts`, `packages/llm-providers/src/openai-compatible/chat/openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts`, `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`; endpoint match uses actual completion URL including custom-saved connections; fingerprint attributes provider credential without Freebuff account, domain-separated hash, key never enters body, SDK handles stop markers locally.

reference.title: Onboarding referral shuffles options, retires Reddit GitHub Copilot
reference.summary: Referral question gains `shuffleOptions: true` with other pinned last and drops `reddit` and `github`, `role` drops `pm` and `non_technical`, `subscriptions` drops `copilot`, because first-chip position bias handed advantage to whichever channel listed first and dropped channels honestly read as `OTHER_OPTION_ID`. Change lives in Shared/Core via `common/src/constants/freebuff-onboarding.ts` in `FREEBUFF_ONBOARDING_QUESTIONS` plus `ONBOARDING_LEGACY_OPTION_IDS` and new tally helpers. Retired ids remap under current rules with `data_ml` to `professional_dev` and `discord`, `blog_news`, `reddit`, `github`, `designer`, `pm`, `non_technical`, `copilot` to `OTHER_OPTION_ID`, `ONBOARDING_TALLY_VERSION` bumps to 3 to trigger full rebuild on mismatch, and `applyOnboardingAnswersToTally` folds legacy ids in place with `sign` -1 for resubmission while `emptyOnboardingTally` seeds every current option at zero.

reference.title: Add freebuff-countries constants for free-mode tiering
reference.summary: New `common/src/constants/freebuff-countries.ts` defines `FREE_MODE_TIER_ONE_COUNTRIES`, `FREE_MODE_TIER_TWO_COUNTRIES`, and `FREE_MODE_TIER_THREE_COUNTRIES` sets, plus `FREE_MODE_ALLOWED_COUNTRIES` union and `formatCountryCodes` helper. Groups rank by advertiser value per account (measured 2026-09-12); SG and IL exited full access 2026-09-15 due to 8-25% ad fill vs 43-80% baseline, earning ~1/10 US rate. KR remains tier-three by decision despite poor fill. Lives in `common` to avoid server-only geoip/db deps in client bundles; `packages/internal/src/free-mode-country/allowed-countries.ts` re-exports to sync meter and public FAQ copy.

reference.title: Add sponsored delivery client diagnostics
reference.summary: Added `sponsoredDeliveryClientDiagnostics` in `common/src/ads/sponsored-delivery-diagnostics.ts` to report client claims. This function derives execution surface and capability contract version from User-Agent and OS fields. It explicitly never authorizes delivery or execution. The output includes `client_os`, `execution_surface`, `capability_contract`, and `capability_inspection` status.

reference.title: CLI adds first-tab discount logic to model selector and session API
reference.summary: CLI model selector and session hooks integrate new `firstTabDiscount` logic via `freebuff-first-tab-discount.ts` and `freebuff-price-selection.ts`. The `freebuff-session-api.ts` adds `x-freebuff-first-tab-discount` header and handles `first_tab_discount_changed` status, while `freebucks.ts` applies account-wide discount quotes to session prices. Scope covers `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`, and shared types in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts`. Detail: `firstTabQuoteForSession` checks holder instance ID, surface type, and expiry timestamps to dynamically apply or release the discount before purchase.

reference.title: Add CLI sponsored capability detection and display acknowledgement
reference.summary: New `sponsored-cli-capability.ts` detects project capabilities (framework, package manager, database boundaries) to route ad requests via `/api/ads` instead of `/api/v1/ads`. `sponsored-project-identity.ts` generates a persistent opaque UUID marker for remote-less Git workspaces, ensuring stable targeting without leaking local paths. `sponsored-proposal-block.tsx` now triggers `acknowledgeSponsoredProposalDisplay` on mount, confirming the offer was actually rendered in the terminal rather than just stored in the transcript. Capability inspection data is included in the ad request body only when a project root is detected.

reference.title: First-tab discounted Freebucks prices show in accent colour, picker notice removed
reference.summary: The model selector's per-row Freebucks price chip drops the struck-through regular price in favour of a single discounted price drawn in the accent colour (`highlight` flag on `RowDetail`), so a first-tab-discounted row reads as one price, not two. The old `FREEBUCKS_PICKER_NOTICE` copy and its `FREEBUCKS_RESET_POLICY_COPY` dependency are removed from `freebucks.ts`, and the landing screen's metered-tier notice slot is left empty since each row already shows its hourly price and the header shows the daily pool and reset countdown. This aligns the CLI picker's price display with the Web and Desktop surfaces, where the discounted price is presented without a side-by-side struck regular price. The `RowDetail` type now carries `{ text, warn, highlight? }` instead of `{ struck?, text, warn }`, and `detailText` returns only `detail.text`.

reference.title: CLI binary build ignores repository .env files
reference.summary: The standalone binary build now passes `--no-compile-autoload-dotenv` to `bun build`, preventing the compiled CLI from automatically loading `.env` and `.env.local` from the current working directory. This blocks a repository-driven host override of the SDK's runtime API base URL resolved from `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL` or `CODEBUFF_APP_URL`. Environment variables exported in the user's own shell are still honoured.

reference.title: First-tab discount copy now mentions Web surface
reference.summary: The Freebucks first-tab discount promotional text now explicitly includes the Web surface alongside Desktop and CLI. This corrects the user-facing message in firstTabDiscountCopy so users understand the discount applies across all three sessions. The change is a one-line string update in the shared Freebuff core utilities.

reference.title: First-party primary allocation telemetry schema expanded in Ads Fetch Completed event
reference.summary: The `ADS_FETCH_COMPLETED` event schema in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts` now emits a v1 request-grain primary-allocation telemetry block: `first_party_metrics_schema_version`, `first_party_primary_routing_eligible`, `first_party_primary_routing_reason`, `first_party_primary_route_admitted`, `first_party_primary_admitted`, `first_party_primary_entrypoint`, `first_party_primary_outcome`, `first_party_primary_terminal_reason`, `first_party_primary_requested_placement_count`, `first_party_primary_filled_placement_count`, `first_party_primary_frequency_capped_placement_count`, `first_party_primary_frequency_unavailable_placement_count`, `first_party_primary_candidate_cap_rejection_count`, and `first_party_primary_partial_fill`. This is a telemetry-only addition to the shared `common/` ads logging surface, so dashboards and sampling can reason about primary-cohort admission, partial fills, and per-placement cap rejections without touching campaign or advertiser identity, and without changing any ad-selection or routing logic.

reference.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.178 release bundles Fable 5.1, trust gates, and checksum verification
reference.summary: The Freebuff CLI ships version 0.0.178 via a manifest bump in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.177, packaging the same-day commit sequence that swaps the Fable 5 trial to `anthropic/claude-fable-5.1` (renaming `FREEBUFF_FABLE_5_MODEL_ID` to `FREEBUFF_FABLE_5_1_MODEL_ID` and adding the `agents/tmux-cli-fable.ts` subagent pin), gates registry-fetched executable agents behind the `codebuff` / `CODEBUFF_TRUSTED_AGENT_PUBLISHERS` / `trustedAgentPublishers` trust union in `@codebuff/sdk`, and hardens installs by verifying each downloaded archive's sha256 against the `binaryChecksums` map stamped into the package manifest by `write-binary-checksums.js`. Also included are the off-peak Freebucks pricing row chip via `freebucksOffPeakCopy` in `common/src/util/freebuff-off-peak-price.ts`, the placement daily cap default raised to 10000 cents in `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`, the generic advertiser setup invitation schema in `common/src/ads/generic-setup-invitation.ts`, owner-only POSIX modes (`credentials.json` at `0o600`, config dir at `0o700`) rehealed by `tightenCredentialsFileMode` in `cli/src/utils/auth.ts`, runtime `CODEBUFF_APP_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL` scheme/host validation in `common/src/util/runtime-app-url.ts`, foreign client detection signals in `common/src/constants/foreign-client-signals.ts`, Meta CAPI landing tracking via `common/src/meta-capi.ts` (META_GRAPH_API_VERSION v26.0), Slack webhook stripping from `sdk/test/setup-env.ts`, bearer-token authentication on `validateAgents`, rate-limited analytics events in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`, authenticated agent validation from `cli/src/hooks/use-agent-validation.ts`, and direnv steering variable drops across `cli/src/init/direnv.ts` and `getAgentRuntimeImpl`.

reference.title: Direnv steering vars dropped and registry fetch disabled toggle
reference.summary: The CLI's direnv loader now drops any `.envrc`-exported variable matching a steering prefix (`CODEBUFF_`, `FREEBUFF_`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_`, `OVERRIDE_*`, `NODE_OPTIONS`, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED`, `SSL_CERT_*`, `BUN_*`, `LD_*`, `DYLD_*`) rather than importing it into the CLI's own `process.env`, emitting one warning that names the ignored keys. The SDK also gains a `disableAgentRegistry` option on `CodebuffClientOptions` that, when set, makes `getAgentRuntimeImpl` return `null` from `fetchAgentFromDatabase` - so unknown agent ids fail as "not found" instead of falling back to `codebuff/<id>@latest` on the public registry, closing the executable-`handleSteps` eval path for hosts that bundle every agent they will ever run. Together these tighten the trust boundary between a repository's environment and the credential-bearing Freebuff process: direnv may no longer reconfigure the launcher or API plane, and a server-embedded runner can refuse registry fallbacks into a code path from a publisher account it never intended to execute.

reference.title: Analytics event enum gains rate-limited variants for API endpoints
reference.summary: New `*_RATE_LIMITED` members were added to the `AnalyticsEvent` enum in `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`, instrumenting rate-limit rejections for web search, docs search, gravity index, logs ingest, and additional API surfaces across 6 additions. They follow the existing naming convention of sibling `api.*_auth_error`, `api.*_validation_error`, and `api.*_error` variants and flow into the shared telemetry layer in `common/`, so dashboards and sampling can bucket throttling rejections uniformly. These are inert schema additions that record rejections without altering endpoint rate-limit enforcement, mirroring how `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` in `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts` exempts high-signal failure events from 1% sampling. Affected package: `common/src/constants/analytics-events.ts`, consumed by `cli/` via the analytics transport and by the shared sampling/util layer.

reference.title: Agent validation now sends bearer token on remote calls
reference.summary: Remote agent validation via `@codebuff/sdk`'s `validateAgents` now attaches an `Authorization: Bearer` header derived from the `apiKey` option in `ValidateAgentsOptions`. The CLI hook `cli/src/hooks/use-agent-validation.ts` supplies that key from `getAuthToken()`, so a logged-in CLI behind a shared NAT is admitted on its own per-user budget once the endpoint's per-IP budget is spent while remaining anonymous otherwise. The endpoint `/api/agents/validate` itself is unchanged; only the optional authenticated header is added.

reference.title: Freebuff ads Slack webhook URL stripped from test env
reference.summary: The shared test preload in `sdk/test/setup-env.ts` now deletes `process.env.FREEBUFF_ADS_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` before any suite runs, so integration CI or a developer shell that supplies it cannot route fixture campaign notifications to the real `#ads-notifs` channel on every run and retry. Notification tests inject their own `fetchImpl`/`postMessage` transport instead, and `docs/testing.md` records that the Slack sender refuses its default transport whenever the environment is test. The change lives in the SDK test fixture (`sdk/test/setup-env.ts`) and its reference documentation, keeping production webhook configuration out of secretless unit jobs while leaving the production sender configured for real submissions.

reference.title: Foreign client detection adds harness tool names and system prompt markers
reference.summary: common/src/constants/foreign-client-signals.ts now enforces a third layer against request laundering: a request that offers a tool name only a third-party harness ships (Claude Code's `Bash`/`Read`, Codex's `exec_command`, opencode's `webfetch`, etc.) is marked foreign regardless of any genuine Freebuff tool definitions it appends, and a system-role message carrying `You are Claude Code` or `cc_version=` is likewise caught. The two new signals (`foreign_tool_names`, `foreign_system_prompt`) join `foreign_toolset` in the new `ENFORCED_SIGNALS` set consumed by `resolveForeignClientDowngrade`, which downgrades eligible requests to `inclusionai/ling-3.0-tiny:free` unless already on that model. The `unrecognisedToolNames` bounded sample is added to `ForeignClientVerdict` for observe-only logging of requests that clear every enforced rule.

reference.title: Placement daily cap default raised to 10000 cents
reference.summary: The shared placement daily cap default moved from 2,500 cents ($25/day) to 10,000 cents ($100/day) in `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`. The `clampPlacementDailyCapCents` helper retains the existing 500-to-500,000-cent bounds, so any off-ladder value typed into the numeric input still saves as entered; no slider resolution constants changed. The change targets the advertiser self-serve ceiling sizing, not the terminal-width inline ad renderer or Freebuff developer token allowances.

reference.title: Freebuff CLI packaged as 0.0.177 release
reference.summary: The release manifest for the freebuff CLI binary moves from 0.0.176 to 0.0.177 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json. This is a version-bump commit in the same-day sequence that bundles the sponsored proposal setup guidance, crossed-out list prices in the model picker, foreign client detection hardening, and Singapore/Israel access carve-out removal. No dependency, source, or lockfile changes accompany the manifest edit, so the bump is a release pointer rather than a behavior change.

reference.title: Sponsored click ID arg placement and merged report grace window
reference.summary: The advertiserClickId runtime input prompt in sponsored-procedure-inputs.ts now permits the reviewed command to contain the {{advertiserClickId}} placeholder in a command argument, not only the default command-scoped environment-variable assignment, while still forbidding global export, file writes, or commits. sponsored-run-token.ts adds SPONSORED_MERGE_REPORT_TTL_MS (30 days) as a merged-only reporting-grace window so an off-Cloud run can still observe the recorded PR after the run token expires; this is distinct from SPONSORED_RUN_TOKEN_TTL_MS (24h) and is consulted only by the state route's merged report. agentic-ad-events.ts doc text for the retained pr_made enum and the landed stage is clarified (the stored names are kept for Postgres enum compatibility), anchoring the new merged grace TTL to that stage.
